recommendation.summary: Mixed signals. The home, neighborhood, and macro market are strong; the deal math is brutal as a leveraged investment because of NJ property taxes ($21,915/yr). Best fit is an owner-occupant family who values the #16-NJ school district and plans 7+ year hold, OR an all-cash buyer. Investors at retail entry will bleed $30-45K/yr. Flippers need ≤$580K basis for the math to work. Last sale of $779,900 represents a ~10% discount to FMV mid ($870K), attributable to original 1981 condition needing $75-125K refresh.
